subject: Tri-City micro-summits: rotating shared booths & MDF swap
messages:
From: Elena Torres <elena@tri-citytech.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com
Cc: partnerships@tricitytech.com
Date: Sat, 15 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Proposal: Tri-City micro-summits + rotating booth model

Vanessa —

Thanks again for the quick chat last week. TriCityTech is piloting a micro-summit circuit across three regional markets (Seattle, Denver, Austin) and we think Redwood would be a perfect co-presenting partner. High level: two-hour evening micro-summits with a 30-min joint keynote, 45-min customer panel, and a short demo area — we want to avoid the typical expo chaos.

We have a proposal outline and a suggested MDF swap: TriCity provides venue/attendee lead capture and we offer a fixed MDF commitment that gets offset against future joint demand-gen. We also propose rotating the shared booth ownership each night so both brands get floor presence and lead ownership by geography.

Attached is an initial MOU and an ops spreadsheet (names and rough budget). Can you confirm if Redwood would be open to:
- MDF swap instead of a straight co-fund for the pilot
- rotating booth ownership model (one brand staffed as lead per city)
- a mutual action plan with target lead counts per city

Happy to jump on a quick 30-min call this week to iron details.

Best,
Elena Torres
Head of Partnerships, TriCityTech
Elena Torres
Attachments: TriCity-MDF-term-draft-v1.pdf, shared-booth-rotation-ops.xlsx

Subject: Re: Proposal: Tri-City micro-summits + rotating booth model

Elena —

Appreciate the deck and the MOU. This sounds like a high-signal pilot and aligns with our regional GTM push. Quick responses to your asks:

- MDF swap: potentially yes — we need the draft to include clear KPIs (MQL targets, lead qualification workflow, and what counts as a creditable lead).
- Rotating booth ownership: fine by us if we can agree on staffing minimums and lead capture handoff procedures (QR/wristband scan + HubSpot owner assignment).
- Mutual action plan: we'll propose a MAP template with timelines and deliverables.

Next steps I propose:
1) Internal sync (Marissa and Karthik looped) to review ops and staffing constraints — can you give us expected day-of headcount and AV needs per city?
2) Draft a one-page SLA addendum to the MOU with lead conversion KPIs and credit rules — we can share via Google Drive.
3) 30-min alignment call Monday or Tuesday next week? I have windows Mon 10:00-11:00 PT and Tue 13:00-15:00 PT.

Thanks — excited about this.

Vanessa Ortiz

Redwood Inference

Looping Marissa in (oops — that's me). Quick ops notes:

- Day-of staff: minimum 2 SDRs + 1 solutions engineer per city to support demos; prefer 3 SDRs if expected headcount > 120.
- AV: single projector and mic for keynote, breakout room (or small theater) for demos. If TriCity handles venue, we need AV contact and a run-of-show by D-7.
- Booth rotation: we should specify booth handoff windows (end of day + lead reconciliation within 24 hours).

I drafted a one-page SLA template (see Drive link) and populated city lead targets based on TriCity's attendee estimates (in the ops spreadsheet). I also added a staffing cost estimate for the staffing nights.

Elena / Team —

Thanks — quick logistics and procurement flags from my side:

- MDF accounting: we need a vendor-grade invoice and a simple redemption schedule. If TriCity will offset MDF against future demand-gen credits, that needs a clear ledger entry and expiry (we're proposing 12 months).
- Insurance / indemnity: will the MOU include standard event insurance requirements? If TriCity owns the venue, we'll ask for a certificate of insurance naming Redwood as additional insured for the event dates.
- PO & payment: Redwood requires an invoice or a DocuSign-backed agreement before MDF is disbursed.

If you can include those in v2 of the MOU we'll be closer to sign-off. Also, can you provide HubSpot or CSV export field mapping so we can automate lead ingestion post-event?

I'll join the alignment call — Tue 13:30 PT works for me.

— Karthik
